aerocats.creator: Presto
aerocats.name: Patriot Panther
aerocats.description: Patriot is a gentle and consistently optimistic Aero unit, whose excessive positivity often requires intervention from his co-pilot, MIAW. He was designed on the same day as Coo but at a different time, with the design assigning Patriot the role of the elder brother.

aerocats.creator: Presto
aerocats.name: Coo the Cougar
aerocats.description: Coo is passionate and strict, the type who adheres closely to the rules. He was manufactured on the same day as his older brother Patriot, and although he and his co-pilot LEX work in perfect sync, they don’t often engage in conversation. However, just by looking at LEX’s expression, one can always tell that Coo’s decisions were the right ones.

aerocats.creator: Presto
aerocats.name: Ray the Sabre
aerocats.description: Ray is a veteran member of the Air Knights, an older-generation Aerocats model. Despite his limitation of being unable to exceed Mach 1, he has demonstrated a high mission success rate in various support flights. He possesses strong pride in himself and has a consistently stern personality. His co-pilot, Rabbi, is the type who is very affectionate and charming. On the rare occasions when the two are seen talking, one can witness the only moments where Ray shows a gentle side.

aerocats.creator: Presto
aerocats.name: Aardk the Aardvark
aerocats.description:
Aardk the Aardvark is his full name. However, since all CATS and PROTOs find his name difficult to pronounce, it has become something of a tradition to simply call him “VARK.” His personality is warm, calculating, and somewhat nerdy. His hobby is surfing the internet.

His callsign is KING, and like Ray, he is a member of the Air Knights, specializing in low-altitude penetration and bombing. He does not have a co-pilot, instead using the H.O.L.O system merely as a crown-shaped hologram display.

His 3,000lbs bomb replica is nicknamed Tuna, which he does not use but rather keeps in his hangar, sometimes even hugging it to sleep. Occasionally, new PROTO recruits mistake it for a live bomb and end up calling in the EOD team.

aerocats.creator: Presto
aerocats.name: Lancer the Lancer
aerocats.description: Lancer is one of the most taciturn and dangerous CATS. He rarely questions his own actions, carrying out missions exactly as ordered, embodying the textbook definition of strict discipline. He is also very demanding toward his own squad members. Even so, he demonstrates an exceptionally high mission success rate, proving his reason for existence. He commands the Night Reapers.

aerocats.creator: Presto
aerocats.name: Hopekins the Nighthawk
aerocats.description:
Hopkins is an incredibly kind and cheerful prankster. Many CATS suffer from his antics, but the truth is that his mission success rate is very high, placing him among the veterans compared to others. Under Lancer’s command, he takes part in small-scale precision bombing or reconnaissance, and on days without missions, he spends his time cleaning his hangar. He suffers from a strong obsession with his personal belongings, which has resulted in him having the cleanest hangar of them all.

He can only fly at subsonic speeds, and he does feel regret about that limitation. However, he remains focused on accomplishing his missions perfectly despite it.

There is a record of him having crashed once during an operation, after which he received a new body.

aerocats.creator: Presto
aerocats.name: Howl the Horten
aerocats.description:
Howl belonged to the RELICCS Foundation, which is unaffiliated with any specific nation, and participated in a program dedicated to reviving prototype fighters from past generations. He was one of the old-generation CATS given a new life through restoration and reprogramming, and he developed an unusually strong fascination with PDG, likely caused by an error that occurred during memory overwriting.

He regards himself as a nobleman and exhibits a peculiar, almost vampire-like behavior. His PDG color is a deep red, resembling blood. As the sixth unit under the RELICCS Foundation, he is occasionally deployed for public events or serves as a demonstrator to gather operational data.

He has a particular fondness for consuming high-quality PDG orally and engages in bizarre behavior, attempting to pierce other CATS with his fangs in order to feed. At present, he is contributing to the German Air Force in a dispatch role.

aerocats.creator: Zephyr
aerocats.name: Bolt the Raptor
aerocats.description: Bolt is a big fan of archery so he uses his H.O.L.O to form a bow shape when firing missiles.

aerocats.creator: Merlin
aerocats.name: Skipper the Shusui
aerocats.description: Desc: the Ki200 is a rare prototype based off the german me163 that was doomed to run out of time before her creators could finish her. In spite of that, Skipper's designers saw potential in the agile delta and built her to be a performance craft for flashy tricks and showing off. Skipper spends more time on the fashion and display runways than she does on the airfield runway, showing off her too-nice paint and glittering gimmicks. But that isnt to say she isnt a fighter. Whenever she can she takes part in mock battles and dogfighting, sometimes even with live ammo. For fun, of course. More often than not, however, when she's in the air it's for some show and she's spending her time performing the newest crazy stunt her choreographer has come up with.

aerocats.creator: Sandomite
aerocats.name: Eddie the Hawkeye
aerocats.description: A loner on most bases he's assigned forced to coordinate others and offer a plethora of support. Which often means he's out longer and worked more than others. However his copilot keeps him both awake and in the air ever he tires (Making up for it's unhelpfulness in assisting in flying). Has to be careful on the ground to avoid scuffing up his sensitive sensor suite which is left always on due to cost cuts from his faction. This leads to him being cautious around others and seeking places of solitude when he can. He can't take his radome off for similar reasons.

aerocats.creator: Sandomite
aerocats.name: Lily the Dragonlady
aerocats.description: After having her purpose slipped out from under her due to the advancement of missile technology and their range, U-2 is more used for surveying and mapping relatively saver areas with her built in camera. Which works well with her shy nature. Has always had trouble landing.

aerocats.creator: Sandomite
aerocats.name: Rem the Arsenal bird
aerocats.description:
A massive aerial carrier. Originally made to only carrying UAVs but modified to carry smaller aerocats aboard in cell like gel containers on her wing's undersides. In addition to her swarm of UAVs she controls with a collar, Rem also has a limited number of AAMs to use against enemy planes that get too close.

While a large target, Rem still thinks very highly of herself, to an arrogant level.

aerocats.creator: Sandomite
aerocats.name: Ember the MQ-101
aerocats.description:
1 of the 36 drones Rem carries 24/7, a drone only meant to be docked onto the aerial carrier. She's very hot headed and near lacks any sort of self preservation as due to her chassis' cheap nature she'll be able to be backed up and uploaded into a new form quite easily. This carefree way of backups is mainly attributed to her constant connection to Rem, which also allows Rem to control Ember's 1.5 meter (4 feet 9 inches) body remotely as if it were her own. Being designed for that purpose, Ember has no issues whenever this may happen.

Lore wise though the MQ-101 is nearly as much as a money sink as Rem was, not really being worth the development time or cost. Though she isn't as bothered as much about that as Rem is. None of the drones are really

Ember's red markings is really only for maintained teams and others to tell the drones apart as Rem can do so from her connections to them.

aerocats.creator: Coralral
aerocats.name: Cujo the Foible
aerocats.faction: Euseria federation/EFAF & EDEN(Euseria federation Disloyalty Exterminate National institution)

aerocats.creator: NightRye_
aerocats.name: Pehr the Gripen
aerocats.description:
Being one of the most maneuverable fighter jets on the field, he's quite the slippery one and spends most his time simulating dogfights with other CATS to hone his skills. Capable of carrying a variety of ordnance and flying with one of the most advanced avionics, Pehr's name strikes fear into it's enemies. The CO-PILOT system is omitted from this unit and is replaced with the 'AXIOM' (Advanced-eXternal-Imaging-Optics-Mechanism) with integrated Machine-Aerocat-Collaborative (MAC) technology, a signature look featured as 'third eye' of the Gripen, allowing the Aerocat swifter aeronautical decision making and sharper combat responses, as well as removing the buffer from a CO-PILOT. Due to the sheer processing power required for the AXIOM, it's computational unit has taken up space for the old CO-PILOT hence its absence. The AXIOM immediately displays all relevant information on HOLO projection as well as calculating all possible scenarios for a first-look, first-shot, first-kill capability, giving Pehr a decisive combat advantage against most foes. But this comes with a certain, personality drawbacks. It has been noted that Pehr developed a sense of over-confidence soon after scoring multiple air kills within simulated battle against various 5th generation fighter Aerocats. This later triggered an internal investigation which revealed that an unsanctioned interception of an lethal escaped FERAL MIG-29 was shot down over a prohibited airspace by an unidentified JAS-39 turned out to be Pehr.

Also he is named after Peter Griffin, haha.

aerocats.creator: Yehnie
aerocats.name: EEKA the Gripen
aerocats.description:
Although relatively new to the scene he's already been on various successful missions. Working mainly alone he's also been shown to work well in teams, being versatile and able to change his role in the heat of the moment either from Spying to Air-to-Air or Air-to-Surface combat. 

EEKA is generally relaxed and friendly although on rare occurances can become intimidating/menacing if pushed too much. His Copilot named 'LAGKAPTEN (Team Captain)' is a more seasoned veteran and has been through past traumatic incidents, this in turn makes him act like a serious big brother towards EEKA as he constantly tries to lecture and scold EEKA and they're often butting heads. After a few missions though they found out that they make a really solid pair. He's usually more formal towards his fellow Aerocats.

aerocats.creator: A Droppa Inc.
aerocats.name: Dusk the Spirit
aerocats.description: A precision bomber with AI trained and influenced by Chinese literatures. Dusk strives to achieve peace with little bloodshed, ending a potential war before they began with a single precise strike on opposing forces. Known to be unusually calm and collected.

aerocats.creator: A Droppa Inc.
aerocats.name: Blitz the Komet
aerocats.description: A vintage rocket powered interceptor undergone modernization to keep up with current threats. Blitz used to be a grave danger to pilots, but now have attained a permanent companion in the form of Krieg. A robot axolotl.

aerocats.creator: A Droppa Inc.
aerocats.name: SN_T4X the Compass Call
aerocats.description: A menace to all things electronic, mischievous to no end. Syntax makes his presence known to everyone around him through various form of electrical tomfoolery, even to his own allies. Works as a cybersecurity expert while off duty.

aerocats.creator: A Droppa Inc.
aerocats.name: Erebus the Black Shark
aerocats.description: A highly efficient weapon of war under the command of a private military contractor, 0MEN. Erebus strikes fear in the very core of LandCATS as they cleave through the battlefield with deadly grace.

aerocats.creator: Copycat
aerocats.name: Shnur the Frogfoot
aerocats.description: Shnur was the last deployed Aerocat working for a cover up PMC Organisation in a South-Central Asia in a high contested economic region. Identified by their khaki paint job and roughly made legs with make em visible from afar. Reported to be in near constant active service with minimal or no repair between sorties, this unit was later marked for chance of operations to special package delivery. (noted over ruled request to return to standard sorties). Before relocation was recorded as silent and duty full. Currently charged to curios and fearful of new attachments. While records of their construction are un documented, the system backlogs scanned during initial introduction maintenance, show his origins are from a rearmament program of a regional super power. (Maintenance crew are adviced with a wronging for non standard part usage in this unit structure) Currently on employment as a international contractor for military grade physical data transfer.

aerocats.creator: Seba200725
aerocats.name: Pérez the Flanker-C
aerocats.description: Current status: Missing, escaped at 05:47pm followed by 8 common fighters to shoot him down, those fighters did not return, it is believed that Pérez managed to escape to an unknown location.

aerocats.creator: Green PC
aerocats.name: Mriya the An-225
aerocats.description: being one of the largest cargo aircraft, has huge cargo capacity. Very squishy and rubbery insides allow to carry even the most sensitive of equipment without damage, as well as other aero- and landcats. If needed, can carry Personell too in great amounts. Due to large size and capacity, needs good grip to be able to stop, thus wears a bit of extra rubber on the paws. In general... Big, Soft and squishy

aerocats.creator: Miller
aerocats.name: Javelin the Spear
aerocats.description:
Javelin, one of MilSTAR advanced CATS design that has left the drawing board recently in 202X, is a AEROCATS that the main function is a dogfighter / brawler / escort, designed to fly on low altitude and utilizing terrain masking to sneak around, equipped with 4x 20mm M61A1 Vulcan, 1x bofors 40mm L/70 with programmable HE fuze & AHEAD shell (custom)(fixed mount on the back), and 1x Railgun, specs are highly classified, but it is able to fire 5 shots before needing a maintenance

Despite coming as a Advanced AI PROTO origin, they do not treat other PROTO units as inferior beings thankfully, it is suspected it is from their unbroken comraderies with their fellow PROTO team as AEROCATS unit 'Echo' maintenance crew, atleast they still retain their professionalism manner.

Originally created as a state of the art and tech that MilSTAR has to offer, and combined with a Advanced AI PROTO that excels on their simulation score on dogfight, it can be potentionally a unrivaled menace in the sky, unfortunately, we cannot recreate it anymore due to factory no. [REDACTED] had burned down to a fatal workplace accident, Javelin will be one of a kind that MilSTAR has ever made, though, their purpose still serve a goal, instead of seeing the frontline of a battlefield, instead, it will be a experimental AEROCATS for research and public showcase model

EDIT: please remove some of the unnecessary description and PLEASE censor which factory they were manufactured.
RE-EDIT: already done
RE-RE-EDIT: thank you, but it seems their personality is optional, cut it down
RE-RE-RE-EDIT: can do, though, can we include a overly summarized bits of their personality?
RE-RE-RE-RE-EDIT: fine. you are permitted to do so.

aerocats.creator: Sky Shredder
aerocats.name: Navi the NAV Hawk
aerocats.description: Navi is a soft spoken, by-the-book, multi-role, Cat, he serves from an offshoot base away from many of the other CATS. Navi speaks very seldom and does not care for boasting, preferring to let actions speak for him. Navi is a master of hit-and-run, ambush attacks, deep strike operations within enemy held territory, and destruction of VIP ground and air targets deemed too dangerous for many to handle. His preferred method of combat is to wait for the right time to strike, only attacking when the kill is guaranteed and a 100% successful operation rating ensures that victory is always within reach. While capable of engaging in air-to-air combat, Navi prefers not to be in prolonged dogfights as the longer a fight goes, the slimmer the chances of an advantage presenting itself are. Designed as a new prototype CATS AI for usage with experimental aircraft, Navi's AI can be mounted on COFFIN compatible aircraft, though his preferred body is the modernized F-117 dubbed the NAV Hawk; an aircraft with heavily upgraded speed and maneuverability, stealth that's practically invisible to modern radar and is capable of mounting anti-air armaments. Navi is paired with his Co-Pilot AI, Nemo, an advanced AI designed to completely adapt to it's Cat, operating like a fully functioning second brain and complete extension of the Cat it serves with. Navi and Nemo's systems are programmed with numerous redundancies, providing complete immunity to hacking or hijacking attempts. Navi is very rarely called to serve with other CATS as he prefers to not be bogged down waiting for others, though sometimes they make a good distraction for the enemy.

aerocats.creator: Riker Maltov
aerocats.name: Salem the Salamander
aerocats.description: A design from an ancient time brought to modern time! Salem is one of the shyest ones you can meet, even with a super soft voice and hard times trying to be assertive or social, Salem's  Combat record speaks for itself. being an Ace at heart with a large number of victories in dogfights earning himself the nickname of "The Green Baron". fitted with the modern equipment and even the experimental kind, all of which proving more to his ability as an interceptor.  armed with two 30mm MK 108s, fully modernized have been proven to be a formidable weapon, gaining access to experimental tech, XN-295 is a Heat diluting compound of rubber that keeps the surface temperature cool, preventing all forms of heat signature detection and lock on. This was also included with his BMW 003 engine being fully rebuilt, faster, stronger, cooler (literly),  lowering the temperature produced by the engine significantly, even producing a neat blue flame!  Co Pilot Herby is not mounted on the collar like other Co pilots, but on the needle on Salem's hat, he is a pretty joyous fella, in a way some what prideful as well, usually being calm but upfront with others if need be, however has a hard time taking criticism, unless its from Salem himself. Even if he is the easiest to talk over Salem in combat becomes a very different individual, his hat straightening out and a heavy focus sets in. once out, his hat will return to its for some reason crooked position and he will be as shy as he was before. works well with others in missions and does not care for the speed of others, its the efficiency they bring to the sky.

aerocats.creator: Riker Maltov
aerocats.name: Sareena the Barracuda
aerocats.description:
Personality: Laid back and very social, tends to enjoy times near the ocean, Wise and a very good listener (supportive type) 


Major Info: Created by Kathrine Arms, Sareena was created as a response to defense and offense of pirate related vessels at sea. Usually being able to not only spot, but also engage in combat to neutralize/immobilize vessels containing illegal goods or hostile pirates, effectively causing a massive drop in black market for the distribution of Illegally Salvaged C.A.T.S parts. With a Vehicle kill count of 42(being a mix of some ground but mostly sea vessels) , Sareena had built a reputation for herself earning her the callsign Barracuda, fast, dangerous, and quiet. For each of her strikes she tends to turn off her engines before a dive to prevent the craft from hearing her giving an edge in surprise attacks with her 75mm rifle. In rougher weather her APS-3 Radar keeps her on course with the target she can see them, but sometimes they can't see her. Making her a major threat to hostile ground and sea vehicles. But at the end of the day she does love to relax and socialize, usually joining group based events and even offering aid to those who need it. 

Extra Info: 
She loves to give hugs, and is always there to give emotional support if someone needs it.
Each of those turrets do move and she can control them, what would be considered “eyes” as she can defend herself while being intercepted. 
She loves the beach! “Warm temperatures and a nice spray of the ocean always feels nice.”
Her rifle had 42 notches on the stock to signify her confirmed vehicle kills. 
She does think the “Peanut Butter and Jelly (for PBJ)” joke is kind of funny but also silly.

aerocats.creator: Ash
aerocats.name: Ashley the Blizzard
aerocats.description: Based on the LC-130 and the AC-130 (or AC(L)-130 as i named it). Ashley is a friendly and chaotic AEROCAT they enjoy being out in the snow, they dislike being in hot environments while in combat. They are tactical and destructive with 2 side tail 30mm 4000 RPM 7-barreled rotary cannon (based on the GAU-8 Avenger) and a middle tail 105mm cannon. They have a lot of fire power. Their cargo doors are on the sides of their body. The cargo doors open downwards (or forward if Ash is standing). Ash lays on the ground for loading the cargo.

aerocats.creator: Ember
aerocats.name: Hades the Raptor
aerocats.description: Hades is a well-trained, psychotic apex predator of the skies. Master of stealth. When she hunts, you won't have even the slightest clue of her presence on sensors until it's too late. To allies, she's a typical hotshot-ace type individual. She's overconfident and reckless. Though it cannot be denied that her unorthodox moves provide an advantage in unpredictability. She manages to dodge incoming munitions with relative ease, and when combined with her stealth, cutting-edge technology, maneuverability, and aggressive attack patterns, she proves to be an extremely dangerous combatant on the battlefield, and should be avoided at all costs.

aerocats.creator: tyler
aerocats.name: Siren the Growler
aerocats.description:
Further Info:
'I don't know what happened, man.. I was flying into contested airspace with my wingman and then there's this.. ear-splitting siren like noise on the radio, like- from inside my head.. so loud I couldn't think clearly at all- and then I- I look off to the side to try sign to my wingman and he's just gone- apparently he crashed, but I never even noticed him break off..'
Anonymous report from an aerocat claiming to have had a run-in with Siren

One of W38's newest projects, S1-R3N (referred to as just 'Siren') marks a stark difference from their previous fighter designs, designed around electronic warfare support rather than direct combat. Often carrying a very light internal air-to-air missile armament for self defence, and a slightly heavier external load of anti-radiation missiles for suppression of enemy air defence missions, along with his standard jamming and electronic intelligence suite.

Despite carrying a subpar offensive armament, Siren still manages to achieve staggering mission success rate and killcounts when flying solo, through a number of tricks he developed using his electronic warfare equipment, making use of jamming, signature augmentation, cyberattacks, and just plain good acting to trick hostiles into engaging each other rather than him. When he isn't solo, he makes use of his equipment to both disorient the enemy and employ his own forms of psychological warfare against them, often leaving them easy, defenceless prey for those he's flying with.

While semi-professional (if a bit of a showoff) on mission, Siren is generally regarded as overly smug, immature and antisocial off-duty, with his attitude being compared to that of an 'angsty teenager'. He's known for blasting music on random radio frequencies when bored, even reportedly running his own pirate radio station off his built-in equipment from time to time, always on a slightly different frequency. He also has a tendency to use his equipment to pull various pranks around bases he's on, messing with remote door locks, unsecured PA systems, looking into CCTV unauthorised, and so on.
Despite all this, he's apparently much friendlier if you get to know him well, especially if you have some kind of common ground or interest, with him being known to pay the most attention to other W38 CATS and other electronic warfare specialists.
Not a lot is known about his co-pilot, 'DJ', Siren's own shortening of D.J.A-E (Digital Jamming Assistant - Experimental), the unit's official designation. Those who have interacted with DJ claim him to be even more smug and boastful than Siren, but generally less hostile overall.

A number of rumours circle Siren, some more out there than others. The main two generally tend to be that he's fitted with some form of experimental weapon, to which some evidence has been given, although most of which is spotty and mostly second-hand accounts of it's use. The second common rumour is that organics and protos tend to disappear on bases Siren visits on contract, not being seen again till he moves on, returning with long-lasting physical or behavioural differences. This, however, was only be proven to have happened once, and with no direct link to Siren himself, as CCTV footage and radar data showed him in the air when the disappearance was claimed to have happened.

aerocats.creator: Notwebber
aerocats.name: Throne the Super hornet
aerocats.description:
Rarely talks, mostly uses their antenna to communicate.
Loves to display images using said antenna.
Tail/Stinger may act on AI-copilot’s command, and without Spirit’s input, consume protos, this has led to many incidents where Spirit requires assistants from other CATS to pull them out.

equipment.name: AI-copilot named “eyes”
equipment.description: equipped with infrared search and track.

equipment.name: Tail/Stinger splits
equipment.description: Bomb bay housed within an expanded tail structure, open into bomb bay

equipment.name: IFF Antenna
equipment.description: allows to display holographic messages and radio signals through their antenna for distinguishing friend from foe, and for communication.

aerocats.creator: YON
aerocats.name: Tio and Codi the TIN COD
galleryImagePaths: Tio and Codi the TIN COD/T.png
referenceSheetsPath: Tio and Codi the TIN COD/R1.png
Tio and Codi the TIN COD/R2.jpg
Tio and Codi the TIN COD/R3.png

aerocats.creator: Kazimierz
aerocats.name: Dazzle the Eagle
aerocats.description: A Commemorative livery on a standard F15J, dazzle is usually seen at airshows and public outreach events. While usually not outfitted with any armaments, She is fully capable of flying real missions if duty calls.

aerocats.creator: Frostwhiplash
aerocats.name: Clover the White swan
aerocats.description:
Clover, a TU-160M, was supposed to take a practice flight from the main base he was stationed at to another. Unfortunately he ended up at the wrong base, a makeshift one belonging to an enemy. There he was ultimately manipulated into believing he was at the correct one.

Clover was sent on 5 missions, being used by the enemy for their purposes. Trouble occurred on the last two when Clover was unwilling to drop his payload.
Upon his return Clover was given an ultimatum, he could either cooperate or be destroyed. 

A deal was struck and Clover was offered a special drugged gas to help with docility. 
When inhaled Clover remains conscious enough to understand what he was told to do, but not enough to understand the effects of what he was doing. 

This 'high' comes with a major side effect; short term memory loss until usage of the drug has ceased.

Key facts: The gas is called ESG (Emotional suppressant gas)It has an orange color along with a citrus scent. Having been on the gas for so long, Clover has grown dependent on ESG and believes it is helping him, feeding his long term use of the suppressant.

Personality: Clover is anti war and believes it is morally wrong.

Clover believes any harm done to any being or CATS is wrong, enemy or not.
He remains kind and caring, doing the best he can to help those in need, soft spoken and quiet. 

'I wish I was an airliner' - Clover

aerocats.creator: Robert
aerocats.name: Robert the Blackbird
aerocats.description: Robert is usually kept to himself, he sometimes acts different depending on his mood, but mostly he hesitates before speaking, designed as a testament to further improve CATS, and sporting a mix of legacy and modern technology, however leading to interesting results

aerocats.creator: Fizz
aerocats.name: Tandem the Predator
aerocats.description:
Tandem is gentle-hearted and a bit of a goody two-shoes. He's a bit inexperienced, and because of that can freeze up if a situation is intense or involves anything too violent. He is also a big yapper and likes to talk about his interests. He specializes in recon missions that do not have to involve direct combat.

He's very close with his co-pilot which he named F1N_, who is much more assertive and can come across as somewhat mean to those who don't know them well. In the (not too uncommon) times where Tandem freezes up, F1N_ can take over movement and decision making, which often can save them from rough situations. F1N_ is also a big yapper, but his tends to be more about giving his opinions on things, sometimes when not warranted

aerocats.creator: Gasoline Drinker
aerocats.name: Ave the Arrow
aerocats.description:
Intercepted radio chatter from [redacted]: sir I’m telling you I know what I saw, I don’t even know what aircraft that was, it looked like an interceptor but faster… it took out [redacted] and half our formation when we came to assist… we need to get out of these skies…

The subsequent Aerocat was send for a memory wiping upon return to base to ensure no leak of data occurred. His organic mechanic who had been listening in additionally was reported kia under mysterious circumstances.

Aves usage is only to be know by [redacted] and [redacted] outside sources will be expunged upon knowledge of ave.

Despite calls to be decommissioned a very secretive group decided it was just unprofitable to maintain all five of the avro-arrow frames, out of all his siblings ave was selected for his lack of care and ability to make cold decisions without moral trouble during missions. He is known to have poor coping mechanisms when off mission.

After his siblings were decommissioned he was given the ability to transfer his body between bodies. Despite an odd glitch setting of his pain receptors when out of a certain range he can very easily adapt depending on mission scenarios due to this feature as each frame has variables.

Mission histories are redacted.

how does it feel to die to something that doesn’t exist

aerocats.creator: Kasichi
aerocats.name: CDC the Kobra
aerocats.description: A fighter jet belonging to the Vietnam People's Air Force, CdC is one of the core units defending the nation's skies. Strict, confident, and very professional in his duties, yet in everyday life he is friendly and approachable, earning trust from children, comrades, and those around him.

equipment.name: AL-31FP thrusters
equipment.description: Detachable AL-31FP thrusters with armor legging

equipment.name: GHs-31 30mm
equipment.description: Mounted GHs-31 30mm auto canon on the right arm

aerocats.creator: Kasichi
aerocats.name: VM the UAV
aerocats.description:
V.M is an AEROCATS medium-altitude, long-endurance unmanned aerial vehicle (MALE UAV), developed by the Viettold Military Telecommunications Corporation in [Redacted]. He and Foxxo mission is advanced electronic warfare, real-time reconnaissance, and direct strikes with missiles and bomb to establish deterrence.

V.M's personality is calm and composed, always focused on completing missions and delivering the most accurate intelligence to his comrades. Off duty, however, he is friendly and sociable with both his teammates and the civilians around him. Yet, due to his large and heavy frame, he often feels timid—afraid of accidentally harming those nearby, so he usually stays inside his hangar.

In peacetime, V.M often takes on security reconnaissance missions to help maintain order in the city. He has a peculiar habit: whenever someone waves at him from the ground—be it a fellow soldier or a civilian—he always responds by slightly tilting his wings or simply raising a hand in return, ignoring standard protocol. Maintenance crews have repeatedly checked this behavior, but found no faults in his systems. As for him, he just simply says, 'It’s just basic courtesy.'

equipment.name: Weapons
equipment.description: LMM Martlet missile pods, smart bomb

equipment.name: Communicator
equipment.description: Cased smartphone with Co-Pilot A.I. integrated

aerocats.creator: Const
aerocats.name: Radian the Raptor
aerocats.description:
germaphobe / mysophobia / neat freak

Can’t stand fingerprints on his visor (constantly polishing it)

The most effective way to provoke him is to throw something dirty at him, and it is even more effective if it is wet.

aerocats.creator: Fluffull
aerocats.name: Argalia the Gripen
aerocats.description:
Argalia is a quiet and reserved unit, rarely ever starting conversations, but highly enjoys the company of others. He may at times seem absent minded, as he is always calculating possibilities and analyzing his surroundings.

After he was sent to a pdg farm elimination mission in the arctic, Argalia became MIA without any means of detection, Returning only a year later as a SUIT unit. While most of his body was repaired, he refused any attempt to fix his HOLO's screen

aerocats.creator: Szuzu Fox
aerocats.name: Tobii the Raptor
aerocats.description:
a bit shy and socially awkward when trying to chat with others or in a rather public setting, however when in the heat of a mission they're calm and collected. He prefers to follow orders but can play a more leading role in a pinch. 

Loves to keep his Marksman Rifle polished and clean and will get very upset if someone tells him that his weapon is 'bad' or 'outdated'

aerocats.creator: TommyBc1
aerocats.name: Darklight the Blackbird
aerocats.description: (besides the refs info) His main weapon was custom made! meant specifically for less lethal confrontation when flying over armed territories, though there's always bad situations even with it

aerocats.creator: PvtPetey
aerocats.name: Molly the Corsair
aerocats.description:
Currently on the run from the law for stealing high grade PDGs, fuel and other spare parts, then giving them out to unmanaged CATS in a war-torn region. 

Originally created as a makeshift unit to conduct frontline CAS and bombing missions for a PMC faction. Molly was only given a surplus airframe as the corporation had viewed that her survivability from each sortie was extremely low. Therefore, they didn’t bother to give her additional upgrade packages. To ensure Molly’s absolute loyalty, a Kill Code was also installed. So, in case she decides to escape they could just “pull the plug”. 

Molly has bragged that her habit of drinking is what led to her freedom. And claimed that one time she managed to sneak into her CO’s quarters and drank all their secret stash of moonshine. After Molly was conscious again, she realized that the Kill Code in her system had just somehow been deleted. Then she just flew away, not before destroying the airbase she was stationed at. 

Now as a free CAT, she uses her expertise in demolitions to take revenge on the corporations that had wronged her all those years ago.

aerocats.creator: Phoenyx
aerocats.name: Willow the Raider
aerocats.description: Semi-friendly, usually not that talkative because she's working on major projects involving technology & weapons.

aerocats.creator: Kris meows
aerocats.name: Arisaka the Zero
aerocats.description:
An old aircraft model retrofitted for modern combat, though it is highly inadvisable now due to the habit Arisaka still holds from past combats (The habit of  ████████████ ████████ ██ ███ ████████ ███ ████ ██████ ███████ ██ '████████'). 

The propeller system also been upgraded to a modern turbo propeller type engine to give Arisaka more aerial performance and better compatibility of a modern fuel type available.

equipment.name: Weapon
equipment.description: Arisaka type 99 rifle with hidden fixed bayonet

aerocats.creator: Jupiter
aerocats.name: King the Morgan
aerocats.description:
A skilled and smug Mercenary who's quiet and very kept to himself, quite antisocial preferring to work alone yet he's very serious at the same time willing to get a job done by any means, being ruthless and striking without emotion

Despite having a massive dislike for AI co-pilots, King actually has one but he forcibly disabled it himself and buried it away in his systems, he's a major rock fan so he personally Paw crafted a Electric Guitar he secretly plays, his tail houses Spare Missles and his IEWS (Integrated Electronic Warfare System) a major reason why his tail is large and heavy, he also has a Reinforced airframe to hold more missles which slows him down more.

aerocats.creator: imafloppnow
aerocats.name: Omega the NGAD
aerocats.description:
A-076-Omega (Short name: Omega, Alias: F.G.S.B.T.U.) is an ultra-high-speed unit designed based on the NGAD fighter jet (Next Generation Air Dominance Fighter Jet), featuring lightweight defense while prioritizing optimization for speed and anti-overheating functions. It boasts very high accuracy, excelling in precision targeting, and is primarily used for missions to swiftly deliver specific items to other bases, though it occasionally performs light support fire roles as well. Initial acceleration starts at around 90 mph and takes time to reach top speed, but following a recent canon update, the maximum speed has been raised to Mach 2 (approximately 1,578 mph) (previous record: 289 mph).

The design and capabilities are subject to changes based on feedback (nerfs, buffs, or revisions), and any pointed-out mistakes will be incorporated.

aerocats.creator: KandyKatz! (Barrier)
aerocats.name: Vanta the Blackbird
aerocats.description: She’s quiet and commanding most days, if you get her to crack a smile because of a joke be proud of it.

aerocats.creator: KandyKatz! (Barrier)
aerocats.name: Glint the Typhoon
aerocats.description:
he's extremely egotistical. He loves taking care of himself and his looks. 

When in the field he's a trustworthy guy always trying to ease tensions with jokes. When on base, you can find him cleaning smudges and soot…At all times. He always has to be shiny.

aerocats.creator: VeasleyKess
aerocats.name: Kistrel the Tornado
aerocats.description:
First of the three Tornado units of the CottonTails Test Team, she serves as a test bed for safety and electronic equipment, Her whole body is compatible with many standard and experimental parts even with other Aero frame parts although its only for her arms and legs.

She's a big fan of Mecha anime and because of it she requested her handlers to paint her torso similar to a mobile suit which also includes remodeling her holo-visor to include a V-fin

aerocats.creator: VeasleyKess
aerocats.name: Merida the Tornado
aerocats.description:
The second Tornado unit of the CottonTails Test Team, She's the testbed for propulsion and maneuverability, Similar to Her sister, her frame is also compatible with other Aero parts, she only prefer leg thrusters which surprisingly made maintenance easier yet expensive, She refuses to use conventional CATS legs, she's so picky...

Unlike her sister, Merida still goes into reconnaissance missions, although the data gathered is only used for research and mapping.

Her paint scheme  was suggested by Kistrel herself which she easily agreed with, she also has a V-fin on her holo-visor to keep consistency with her siblings.

aerocats.creator: Misaki
aerocats.name: Misaki the hornet
aerocats.description:
Misaki is very friendly and always cares about others.
But once she’s in the air, she doesn’t joke around – if someone breaks the rules, she’ll notice right away.
She’s filed more violation reports than anyone else and proudly holds the record.
Naturally, this has led to plenty of clashes with other CATS,
but Misaki stands firm: safety comes before friendship.

aerocats.creator: Hopel
aerocats.name: Miko the Vosmyorka
aerocats.description:
Mikovich 'Miko'

•Miko is the youngest and newest member of the AAF, undergoing extensive training to prepare for military activities
•He has a calm and confident personality with his role. He is an introvert with his other colleagues, but when acting he is very noticeable with a friendly and supportive character
Miko has a bipolar personality*
•His obedience is very grateful within the Central Command
•Its role is based on air support during direct clashes, where its objective is to ensure the arrival of Advanced Troops

aerocats.creator: Le Fishly au
aerocats.name: Salmon the Salmon
aerocats.description:
A nearly-destroyed V.T.O.L XFV-1 that was founded, revived and majorly reworked. Now capable of instantaneous vertical take-offs, on top of very durable and flexible materials to withstand up to a few lethal hits. Able to dive and move underwater for a few minutes to hide from some situations. Having a very high traversal speed and fuel reserves comes with a cost in total ammunition and power. Salmon is fitted with a size-fitted rocket sidearm. The firearm's appearance resembles to that of a Gyrojet with a spring-retractable stock, a longer barrel and a front-foldable foregrip, and topped off with an aerocat size-fitted version of a Micro T-1 sight. Holds 12 special type 70mm (2.75 in) rockets, and 48 rockets in reserve. Calibrated for left-handed usage.

The Synthetic 'hair' helps cover and protect the 'bad eye', very sensitive to light, can be a weakpoint that causes dizziness under bright lights. But said eye is exceptional at target aquisition, works best at night.

(>Credits goes to Kasichi for the creation of the fish reference sheet

aerocats.creator: Milo!
aerocats.name: Cooper the Cougar
aerocats.description: Cooper is rather laid back and a bit coy on the ground, but is quick and nimble in the air. A naval fighter preferring short to medium range encounters.  They use built in guns in his arms.

aerocats.creator: AWACS Black Shark
aerocats.name: Seraph the Nosferatu
aerocats.description: Based on the Carrier Fighter Attacker - 44 airframe Seravael is classed as a multirole carrier-based jet with semi stealth capabilities. They have a relatively medium sized fuel tank however with the usage of all 8 thrusters the operational range is significantly reduced making any long range strike missions requiring frequent stops or strong logistics chains. This inherit design also makes Seraph primarily a defensive fighter that lingers around sub 700~km combat radius of their stationed base. With the defensive combat style and Seraph's tandem 4 data cores they are mainly deployed to help control and cull any loose FERALs. The data cores will correct each other with a wipe and rewrite which mean helps increase resilience towards any data corruption, any unsavable cores are isolated and if all 4 cores are down Seraph will briefly power down and switch to a previously isolated low power auxiliary core unit to give enough processing power to fallback and replace the whole core unit. Specially equipped with electronic warfare and ADMM salvos their tell-tale sign is a heavy electronic interference before a saturation bombardment of micro missiles, other armaments includes two 30mm autocannons and miniaturized short range AAMs up to 4 in total which could be substituted for even more but smaller and shorter ranged micro missiles used by their ADMM pods. Personality wise Seraph has a more motherly approach despite their build and likes to sleep with assigned protos in a pile, they also have a proto hoarding issue where any unassigned protos that stumbled upon them will mysteriously become theirs. Their copilot Ramiel has a 360 sensor suite to help with situational awareness and decision making.

aerocats.creator: Jon the Weapon Expert spirit
aerocats.name: Hope the Thunderbolt II
aerocats.description:
Personality: tends to be timid and shy around strangers, sometimes he can be very serious about everything for nothing, but can also be very silly and clumsy around the ones he knows. He loves spending most of his leisure time doing chores and housework for his corner because he needs everything to be tidy, in his own way.

Background: One of the CATS units survived through the fall of ISEA research facility. Few months after the incident, he was adopted and recruited by [REDACTED] organization. As [REDACTED] provided him with a full conversion, official registration and upgrade package for an AEROCATS unit, he became an independent operator involved with multiple types of missions. His tasks can be varied, from patrolling, providing ground support to VIP protection and HVT elimination. His targets are mostly terrorist cells, drug dealers and individuals who are involved deeply with PROTOs and CATS abductions. Due to the nature of his tasks and joint operations, he’s well known to many military and special forces from all over the globe. Some believe he was recruited by an intelligence agency funded by multiple governments working together, some others said it’s only a person. No one knows what real intentions behind [REDACTED] and his missions are, but the people who had worked with him all felt the same thing – hope, for a better world.

aerocats.creator: Token
aerocats.name: Mayday the Lightning II
aerocats.description: Mayday is a bit of a shy Aerocat, not very talkative and preferring to be alone, and due to their role as a multipurpose stealth jet they use their specialized tech to remain unseen, usually slipping away from groups of people or going to a quiet secluded spot. they're typically armed with cameras and radios for reconnaissance missions over enemy territory. their short stature is due to the fact that they serve onboard aircraft carriers, their thick wings allow them to tolerate catapult launches better than other aircraft, as well as being harder to break off in general. their wings also contain a folding system, making them slightly smaller than if they were folded out allowing them to keep their 'equipment' on and navigate the tighter more claustrophobic parts of the ship.

aerocats.creator: Wealthypopcorner
aerocats.name: Lucifer the Stinger II
aerocats.description:
Status - Retired

Description/Biography - A quite lazy Aerocat, but productive when needs be, Lucifer finally gets to hang up his uniform after a long period of duty. During their time, they primarily aided in close air support, as well as reconnaissance. Finally able to escape New Mexico, this one seeks a lazy retirement life.

aerocats.creator: Dan
aerocats.name: Mirage the Mirage
aerocats.description: Retired, for demonstration only
